items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Shelly Manne was a beautiful cat. He was really a great, great guy.

ctx.x: Coming from Chicago and relocating in the Bay Area.

Yeah. Then we went down to play in L.A. We used to play at Shelly’s Manne-Hole with Charles. Shelly Manne was a beautiful cat. He was really a great, great guy. He loved music and he was a great player too. Did a lot of sessions, movie scores...
